title: WLIE source bundle
description: Offline legal evidence for the WLIE fixture adapter, the benchmark and the evaluation runner: datasets/fixtures/sources/<bundle_id>.json. A bundle holds identities, effective-dated versions, provision text, 부칙, operational guidance and scripted lookup faults. It is read by waymaker_ai.legal.adapters (load_bundle / FixtureAdapter), whose validate_bundle enforces this schema plus the cross-record rules listed under x-cross-record-rules; the package does not depend on a JSON Schema library. Dates are YYYY-MM-DD. A version is addressed by [version_id, effective_date].

provenance.description: synthetic_fixture bundles use obviously fictional law names and may only hold synthetic_fixture records; verified bundles may hold none.

attribution.description: For law.go.kr captures: 출처: 법제처 국가법령정보센터 (law.go.kr).

title_index_coverage.description: partial = an index of current titles only (official and short titles, no former titles): a title missing from it is historical_lookup_required, never source_not_found.

history_coverage.description: Per stable_id: complete when every version of the identity is listed. A stable_id without an entry is treated as partial.

stable_id.description: 법령ID / 행정규칙ID / manual lineage id. The only identity; a title never is.

short_titles.description: 약칭 printed by the official source.

version_id.description: 법령일련번호 (MST). Not unique on its own: one promulgation can be listed once per effective date.

amendment_type.description: 제개정구분 as printed (제정, 일부개정, 전부개정, 타법개정, 폐지 …).

provision_effective_dates.description: Provision key (ProvisionRef.key(), e.g. 제7조 or 제4조제4항) → its own 시행일, for a deferred provision without a separate history row.

official_url.description: Must be on contracts.OFFICIAL_SOURCE_HOSTS in a verified bundle; must be null or non-official in a synthetic one.

content_sha256.description: sha256 of the capture file the version was parsed from.

parse_status.description: complete = every provision of this version is in the bundle, so a missing provision is an authoritative absence; anything else makes a missing provision unavailable, never citation_not_found.

changed_provisions.description: Article keys this version changed; null = unknown (every pending version is then relevant to every provision).

evidence_id.description: Unique across returnable provisions (article, annex, addendum) and guidance. Heading units need one but may share it: they are never returned, and the official JSON puts a chapter and a section heading on one article number.

effective_date.description: With version_id, names an existing version.

provision_key.description: Article-level key compared without spaces: 제73조, 제6조의2, 별표 1, 부칙제1조.

unit_kind.description: heading = 조문여부 전문 (e.g. 제1장 총칙). Heading units exist only so adapters can prove they filter them; they are never returned, even when they share an article number.

paragraphs.description: Printed paragraph number (as a string) → text.

items.description: "paragraph:item" → text; paragraph 0 when the article has no paragraphs; a branch item is "2:3의2".

structure_complete.description: true only when every 항 / 호 / 목 of this provision is in paragraphs / items (목 as printed markers in the item text). Only then is a cited sub-unit that is absent an authoritative absence (L3 citation_not_found); omitted or false makes it unavailable. Independent of the version's parse_status, which covers which provisions were captured, not their inner structure.

mentions.description: Article keys the clause names. A transitional or application clause naming no article is treated as reaching any filing.

faults.description: Scripted lookup failures. The first fault whose operation and match fit a call is returned with its status and no payload.

match.description: Every given key must equal the call's value (title compared after compact(), provision_key without spaces). An empty match fits every call of the operation. topic (or title) matches the guidance topic.

raw_body_kind.description: When set, status must be a failure status (never found / not_found): failure is not absence.

scope.description: Which statuses / procedures the text speaks to. subcodes empty with status_codes set means stated for the parent, which does not establish the rule for any subcode; all_subcodes_explicit only when the source itself says every subcode is covered.

x-cross-record-rules: identities[].stable_id is unique; versions[].stable_id names an identity.
(stable_id, version_id, effective_date) is unique across versions; provisions and addenda name an existing version.
evidence_id is unique across non-heading provisions and guidance; heading units may repeat one.
A synthetic_fixture bundle holds only synthetic_fixture records and no official URL; a verified bundle holds no synthetic_fixture record, and every official_url is on an allowlisted host.
A fault with raw_body_kind set never reports found or not_found.
